messages.author: swarm
messages.text:
What it is: Merged code never reaches the running daemons — a QA-approved, merged fix can sit inert in production for a day
What it solves: WHAT HAPPENS. The swarm merges source to `main`. Nothing recompiles `extension/out/`, and
nothing restarts the long-lived processes that run it. Those processes keep executing the
code they loaded into memory at startup, which can be days old. A fix is green, merged,
closed — and dead.
How it works: A process running an older build than main is reported as stale
